                                    RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.exceptionalPositions (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn) I

                                          (RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.completePrefix default x) /

                                          RiffleUpperV2.FirstMoment.goodCost N (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn) I chi

∀ {ell V F E H S Q beta B D theta delta q eH : ℝ},
  theta ∈ Set.Icc 3 4 →
    0 ≤ delta →
      0 ≤ q →
        ell = V - S - Q →
          0 ≤ Q →
            ell - F ≤ delta →
              V - q ≤ 2 * F →
                V ≤ beta →
                  H ≤ theta * S - B + eH →
                    E = -D → H + 4 * ell - F + 2 * E ≤ (theta + 3) / 2 * beta - B - 2 * D + delta + q / 2 + eH

name: RiffleUpperV2.Hypergeometric.conditionalSamplingTransport
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] (V R A B : Finset α) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ V.card),
  R ⊆ V →
    ∀ (hA : A ⊆ V \ R),
      (0 <
          RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.sampleLaw V m hm).toPMF
            fun (S : RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample V m) => ↑S ∩ R = B) →
        ∃ (hres : m - B.card ≤ (V \ R).card),
          (∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ),
              (RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.sampleLaw V m hm).toPMF
                  (fun (S : RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample V m) => f (A ∩ ↑S).card)
                  fun (S : RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample V m) => ↑S ∩ R = B) =
                RiffleLowerV2.expect
                  (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.samplingParams (V \ R) A (m - B.card) hA hres).law.toPMF
                  fun
                    (x :
                      Fin ((RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.samplingParams (V \ R) A (m - B.card) hA hres).draws + 1)) =>
                  f ↑x) ∧
            ∀ (E : ℕ → Prop),
              (RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.sampleLaw V m hm).toPMF
                  (fun (S : RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample V m) => E (A ∩ ↑S).card)
                  fun (S : RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.Sample V m) => ↑S ∩ R = B) =
                RiffleLowerV2.probability
                  (RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.samplingParams (V \ R) A (m - B.card) hA hres).law.toPMF
                  fun
                    (x :
                      Fin ((RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.Compat.samplingParams (V \ R) A (m - B.card) hA hres).draws + 1)) =>
                  E ↑x
